id: title:jonmcwest:add per team json attribute sniff metrics

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a lightweight, opt-in JSON-prefix sniffing capability and a configuration option for attribute parsing, potentially allowing operators to probe ingestion behavior without full parsing. This could support debugging or compatibility checks for teams on an allowlist, though the benefit is limited to this specific ingestion path.
review.reason: The change introduces a new configuration option, a Prometheus counter, and a sniffing function wired into the ingestion consumer, alongside a schema update adding an optional property. review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and tests are not fully represented in the provided observations, and the actual benefit of the sniffing and configuration option is not demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the visible configuration and schema changes, but the full operational impact and benefit are not established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or benefit claims are inferred. No tier assignment is performed.
